claims.claim: The Echo Atrium document satisfies the canonical Holodeck world contract and malformed identifiers, references, transforms, and effects are rejected.
claims.pass_condition: The validator accepts the example and focused invalid fixtures fail with named errors.
claims.primary_surface: parsed schema plus focused validator execution
claims.counterevidence: An invalid fixture passes or the example fails.

claims.claim: Equivalent canonical worlds compile to the same ordered deck plan and semantic digest.
claims.pass_condition: Repeated compilation and reordered source arrays produce deep-equal plans and equal digests.
claims.counterevidence: Order, clock time, actor identity, or renderer state changes the plan.

claims.claim: Human and machine actors use the same intent schema and transition rules.
claims.pass_condition: Equivalent bounded intents from human and machine actors produce equivalent world movement and interaction effects without actor-only powers.
claims.counterevidence: One actor kind bypasses validation, bounds, collisions, replay protection, or interaction range.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: live human controls plus exposed machine API

claims.claim: An explicit local snapshot restores equivalent state in a fresh controller and rejects tampering or another world.
claims.pass_condition: Save, fresh instance restore, and semantic comparison pass; checksum/world mismatches fail.
claims.counterevidence: State is lost, silently migrated, or accepts a bad checksum.

claims.claim: A person can enter Echo Atrium, move, interact with the beacon, observe the gate response, and use the interface at laptop and phone widths.
claims.pass_condition: The complete bounded journey visibly works without clipping, blank rendering, hidden controls, or console errors.
claims.counterevidence: The scene is blank, input is ignored, the state change is invisible, or controls overflow.

claims.claim: Version zero is a screen simulation and makes no VR, hologram, physical manipulation, scientific reality, or autonomous world-authority claim.
claims.pass_condition: Contracts, UI, documentation, and receipts state the boundary consistently.
claims.counterevidence: Any surface presents a future adapter as currently implemented.
